After about 970 a great oak Christ hangs in the middle of Saint Peter's over Archbishop Gero's grave, larger than a man, his head fallen forward. The sacristan says the head once split, and closed again when the archbishop laid the Host in the crack.
easter_eggs.source: de.wikipedia Gerokreuz: oak, 2.88 m, made for Gero (969-976); the crack is Thietmar's tale

easter_eggs.text: The earth of the market is black and greasy a spade deep: three hundred years of dung, ash, bone and broken pots. Gerhild says it is the only thing in Colonia the Romans did not leave.
easter_eggs.source: the dark layer under the Heumarkt (the Propylaeum dig report, seen only in summary (?))

easter_eggs.text: In April 1062 a boy of eleven in a king's cloak is brought up the strand from the archbishop's ship, wet to the skin and saying nothing. He had jumped into the Rhine rather than be carried off, and a count jumped in after him.
easter_eggs.source: de.wikipedia Staatsstreich von Kaiserswerth: Henry IV, Anno II and Count Ekbert

easter_eggs.text: At low water in a dry September, grey squared stones show in a line across the river toward Deutz. The ferryman steers by them and calls them the emperor's teeth.
easter_eggs.source: Constantine's bridge of 310 on stone piers (de.wikipedia Römerbrücke); whether anything stood above water in these years is unknown (?), and the name is invented

easter_eggs.text: About 1056 an Irish monk at Saint Martin's is writing a chronicle of the whole world and has decided that everyone else has the year of the Lord wrong by twenty-two.
easter_eggs.source: Marianus Scotus at Great St Martin about 1056 (de.wikipedia Groß St. Martin); his reckoning 22 years off the common one is from memory (?)

unlocks.what: your own cup at the ale-house in the tower
unlocks.how: Drink there on three visits and pay what you owe each time.
unlocks.gives: Adaltrud tells you who is on the strand and what left at first light without being asked (rumours and ask_harbour are free here); a bed in the tower (lodge) for nothing; her heirs keep the cup for yours.

unlocks.how: Bring Meginher the true measure (the story colonia.hand_breadth, ending true_measure).
unlocks.gives: Querns and millstones here at his cost and on a tally, to be paid on your next visit; his word for you at Dorestad and at the Andernach landing.

unlocks.what: the carrying of the king's wine
unlocks.how: Deliver the king's grain whole (the story colonia.kings_grain, ending whole_count or gave_the_eighth).
unlocks.gives: Each Martinmas Wido offers a commission: casks from the Deutz estate to Dorestad or Traiectum at a fixed fee, toll-free as the king's goods.

unlocks.what: a letter under the bishop's seal
unlocks.how: Do the bishop's clerk a service: carry his letters, pay for a book, or give him what he wants in the smiths' row.
unlocks.gives: Shown at the river gate and at the churches' landings on the Rhine it stands as a charter (show_charter): no toll on goods carried for the church, and an audience at Traiectum and Mogontia.

unlocks.how: Carry for Bero three times, or refuse him and keep silent for three years.
unlocks.gives: You can tell a true welded blade from a false one anywhere (sample works on sword_blades and swords): no dealer in the north can pass you soft iron under a good name.

unlocks.how: Give alms at the Golden Saints or carry for Erkanbert at the crossing.
unlocks.gives: The Old Saxon baptismal vow for the chest (give_text saxon_vow); Erkanbert's word to the clerk for a sight of the lists.

unlocks.what: a place in the bishop's convoy of 826
unlocks.how: Lie at Colonia in 826 with the bishop's letter or a book given to Saint Peter's.
unlocks.gives: Your boat goes down to Dorestad beside the boat with two cabins: Anskar knows your name from then on, at Sliesthorp and at Birka, and so does King Harald's steersman.

unlocks.what: the leaf with Aldhelm's riddle of pepper
unlocks.how: Answer the glass-cup riddle had from Folcbald at Mogontia (the story mogontia.born_in_the_furnace), then speak with Liutwin, who sells wine and glass on the market; Latin aboard, or the schoolmaster of Saint Peter's to read it out.
unlocks.gives: give_riddle riddle_aldhelm_40_piper (the last link of the set salt_to_pepper); Liutwin's price for green beakers by the crate.

unlocks.what: the schoolmaster's riddle of the dust of water
unlocks.how: Let the schoolmaster of Saint Peter's copy a letter you carry, or sit through one lesson with his boys.
unlocks.gives: give_riddle riddle_symphosius_11_nix; a first step in Latin (learn latin).

unlocks.what: Hrotbert's mark beside the house's name
unlocks.how: Carry the sealed bag to the mint at Mogontia and the count back (the story colonia.one_weight, ending sealed).
unlocks.gives: change_coin and test_silver at Colonia and Mogontia without the usual loss; the flag sv_scale.

unlocks.what: the house's name read at Saint Peter's
unlocks.how: Carry the saints' bodies to Mogontia in 881 (the story colonia.gates_bars_locks, ending saints_upriver).
unlocks.gives: The archbishop's toll forgiven the house for a generation; sanctuary and a hearing at Saint Peter's without a gift; the heirs greeted by name at the river gate.

The editor's pass of 7 October 2026. The story colonia.one_weight now runs only while its three named men live (Madalger of Mogontia to 818, Sigimar of Dorestad to 815: places/mogontia.json, spine.json). Two beats no longer name cards whose years cannot meet theirs (harbour.years_famine.corn_805 comes only in 805-807, harbour.years_arms.mail_buyer only before 805). Diusburg lies below Colonia on the Rhine, so word and boats from the Ruhr mouth come up to it. Charles is king, not emperor, before Christmas 800.
